title: Lansdale has Yamashita's driver tortured to find 12 troves

tellings.quote: troves are there. So what he does is he he kidnaps the driver for General Yakushima who would know where the some of them were, right?

plain: In Manila in 1945, the American intelligence officer Ed Lansdale kidnapped the driver of the Japanese general Yamashita, a man named Santa Romana, because the driver would know where some of the general's hidden treasure troves were buried; the story holds he was tortured until he gave up twelve of them. Dan Sheehan, a researcher, tells Michels this without naming a source. If true, it would mean secret wartime treasure fed later US covert operations.
